description:
Refactor a failing integration test into a unit test using Mockito.

The project 'PaymentSystem' contains an `OrderService` that depends on a `PaymentProcessor`. The current test `OrderServiceTest.java` fails because it instantiates `StripePaymentProcessor`, which attempts to make a real network connection and throws an exception.

Your task:
1. Import the Maven project from `~/eclipse-workspace/PaymentSystem` into Eclipse (if not already visible).
2. Open `src/test/java/com/example/payment/OrderServiceTest.java`.
3. Refactor the test to use **Mockito** to mock the `PaymentProcessor` interface.
4. Remove the dependency on the real `StripePaymentProcessor` class.
5. Configure the mock to return `true` when `processPayment` is called.
6. Run the test (Run As > JUnit Test) and ensure it passes.
